description: This file defines a PHP trait 'StreamDecoratorTrait' which provides decorator functionalities for StreamInterface objects in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package. It includes method wrappers for stream operations, magic methods for dynamic property handling, and placeholder for creating streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a StreamInterface

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to lazily create and access the 'stream' property

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string, seeking to beginning if seekable

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string using Utils::copyToString

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the wrapped stream object, returning $this if the result is the stream

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata from the underlying stream

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the underlying stream

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the pointer to a specified position in the stream

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a string to the stream

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Placeholder method meant to be implemented in subclasses to create streams dynamically
